research.title: Tree of Thoughts with CodeAct Pattern — Thesis
points: Built a Tree-of-Thoughts framework where LLMs generate and execute Python code at each search step instead of free-form text — making reasoning verifiable via sandbox execution
Achieved 89% accuracy on the Game of 24 task (100-puzzle test set) using DeepSeek as teacher and Gemma 4 31B, averaging 45 API calls per puzzle
Built a Dead-End Memory module that skips 30–80% of explored states by accumulating failure patterns across the search tree
Implemented two-level pruning: static heuristics at depth 1, dynamic failure-pattern injection into LLM proposals at depth ≥ 2
Ran a full distillation pipeline: generated 900 annotated reasoning traces, converted them to backtracking examples, and fine-tuned SmolLM-360M — zero API calls at inference
Student model (v2) achieved 100% arithmetic accuracy per step after backtracking augmentation with variable dead-end depths and multi-level targets
Fixed a format compliance gap in Gemma 4 31B (0% one-word compliance) via last-line extraction — recovered 100% label accuracy without changing the model
Documented failure modes: beam selection bugs, extraction inconsistencies, and ground truth labelling errors in the eval suite
